column1: # Book 4 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 4.530-531 ubi coeperunt is a when-clause; the English had made it a flat statement.
# 4.608 omnia quae refers to the places, not the voices.

column2: since, whenever in a greater crowd through a narrow way
the first-beginnings of voices, risen, have begun to go out.
and all the places round about are astir and roused with sound.
